<div class="card-body">
'''Rug Hug''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">毛皮の抱擁</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：ルークとチューイーが一緒に戦闘に参加しているなら、戦闘運命数を余分に2枚加えることができる。2：自分の反乱軍とエイリアンが一緒に戦闘に参加しているなら、戦闘力に4を加えることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Rug-Hug-PSA-82917282.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ウーキーは豊かな感情を持ち、家族や友人を護ることで知られている。チューバッカはいつしかルークを自分の家族の一員として扱うようになっていた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rug Hug.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one. If Luke and Chewie are in a battle together, you may add two extra battle destiny. If you have a Rebel and an alien in a battle together, you may add 4 to power.

'''Lore:'''
Wookiees have rich emotions and are known for protecting family and friends. Chewbacca had come to treat Luke as a member of his own family.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is 毛皮の抱擁.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rug Hug]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
